# MM-P2-L4-RR01 - Maintenance manual - Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1

Revision: Rev C  
Plant: P2, line P2-L4  
Equipment: EQ-P2-L4-RR01

Scope
This document defines routine maintenance actions for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01). It covers required tools, stepwise procedure for mandrel clamp bolt check and main roll bearing lubrication, and acceptance criteria. Refer to SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-03, and SOP-P2-L4-04 for related operating and safety instructions.

Tools
- Torque wrench calibrated for 525 N·m
- Grease gun compatible with specified bearing fittings
- Clean lint-free rags and approved shop solvent
- Personal protective equipment per SOP-P2-L4-03

Procedure
- Isolate energy sources and lock out following SOP-P2-L4-03 before any intervention.
- Inspect mandrel clamp assembly for visible damage or contamination. Clean surfaces with approved solvent and dry with lint-free rags.
- Set torque wrench to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is 525 N·m and apply torque to each clamp bolt in a cross pattern until wrench indicates achieved value.
- After clamping, cycle the clamp mechanism manually to verify smooth operation without binding. If binding occurs, re-inspect components against SOP-P2-L4-02.
- Lubricate main roll bearings using the grease gun until fresh grease appears at seals and fittings. The main roll bearing lubrication interval for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is 195 hours; record lubrication action in the equipment log per SOP-P2-L4-04.
- Remove lockout/tagout and return machine to service following checks in SOP-P2-L4-03.

Acceptance criteria
- Mandrel clamp bolts are secure and set to the mandrel clamp bolt torque for Heat Treat radial ring rolling mill #1 (EQ-P2-L4-RR01) is 525 N·m.
- Main roll bearings show clean grease extrusion at fittings and no evidence of leakage or overheating during initial run.
- Maintenance entry recorded and cites SOP-P2-L4-02, SOP-P2-L4-03, SOP-P2-L4-04.
